# Aaliyan Ahmad

> Personal portfolio of Aaliyan Ahmad, also known as Ibn Ishfaq — a software engineer, founder, product builder and digital creator based in Lahore, Pakistan.

Aaliyan works across backend engineering, web and mobile products, digital systems, Vector Labs, and content creation.

## Portfolio

- [Home](https://aaliyanahmad.tech/): Overview, experience, selected work, services and contact.
- [GetProof.tech](https://aaliyanahmad.tech/work/getproof): Product case study for GetProof.tech.
- [TaskConnect](https://aaliyanahmad.tech/work/taskconnect): Final-year project and local task marketplace case study.
- [ApkaMuaalij](https://aaliyanahmad.tech/work/apkamuaalij): Backend engineering contribution to the ApkaMuaalij healthcare platform.
- [Dental Clinic](https://aaliyanahmad.tech/work/dental-clinic): Dental clinic web experience.
- [Finance Manager](https://aaliyanahmad.tech/work/finance-manager): Finance management project.
- [Dashboards & Internal Systems](https://aaliyanahmad.tech/work/dashboards-internal-systems): Administrative dashboards and internal software systems.
